stories.summary: Investors are seeking to raise over $1.25 billion for real estate and infrastructure vehicles this year. The trend marks a shift from global markets focused on the AI boom. Local firms like Nuvama Wealth Management are leaning in, partnering with property consultancies to target income-generating assets.

stories.summary: DLF and Singapore-based Everstone Group have signed a term sheet to establish a joint venture for investing in IREO. The deal involves a commitment of 37.5 billion rupees. The venture aims to secure a majority stake in the IREO India companies with independent management oversight.

stories.title: Mohali farmers raise land acquisition concerns with GMADA
stories.summary: Village sarpanches and farmer leaders met with GMADA officials to discuss delays in compensation and rehabilitation benefits. The discussion focused on land acquired for development projects, including the Aerotropolis blocks. Affected residents highlighted a lack of basic amenities and ongoing issues with the acquisition process.

stories.title: Five risks for buyers in Khopoli real estate
stories.summary: Khopoli is attracting interest from developers like Shapoorji Pallonji and NeoLiv, with large-scale township projects planned along the Mumbai-Pune Expressway. Experts advise that purchasing land requires careful examination of title chains and registered sale deeds, as buying a plot differs significantly from purchasing a ready-to-move-in apartment.

stories.title: DCCDL rental income rises 9 percent in second quarter
stories.summary: Rental income for the DLF and GIC joint venture, DCCDL, rose 9 percent to 1,481 crore rupees in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Growth was driven by demand for prime commercial assets. Office complexes contributed 1,222 crore rupees to the total rental revenue.

stories.title: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank makes maiden Indian real estate investment
stories.summary: Japan-based Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank has made its first investment in India’s real estate sector by committing to the H-DREAM Fund. The fund is managed by HDFC Capital Advisors and targets a corpus of up to 1 billion dollars. Investor commitments have already exceeded 400 million dollars.

stories.summary: The global branded residences market is projected to grow by 24 percent by the end of 2026, according to Savills. India has entered the top 10 list as the market expands beyond traditional luxury housing. The pipeline currently exceeds 2,000 projects across more than 100 countries.

stories.summary: National median home prices fell 0.4 percent in October to 388,634 dollars, the first annual decline since May 2023. Redfin reports that higher mortgage rates, which averaged 7.33 percent, have weakened demand. Pending home sales reached their lowest level since 2013, excluding the pandemic shutdown period.

stories.summary: Dave Ramsey stated on his show that the median age of a homebuyer is now over 40. He argued that the housing market is merely a symptom, blaming car loans, student loans, and credit card debt for the trend. Debt is the problem, not the house prices.

stories.title: Greater Boston housing options dwindle
stories.summary: A new report finds only six towns in the Greater Boston area offer homes priced under $500,000. As inventory remains tight, the region continues to grapple with significant affordability challenges for prospective buyers. Finding a starter home in the area is increasingly becoming a statistical rarity.

stories.title: Income requirements for Boston buyers rise
stories.summary: Renters in the Greater Boston area now need an annual income of $181,000 to afford a starter home, according to recent data. The figure highlights the widening gap between local earnings and the cost of entry-level property. The threshold for homeownership continues to climb.

stories.title: Eugene-Springfield home sales decline
stories.summary: Home sales in the Eugene-Springfield area fell by over 20 percent in October, a drop exceeding typical seasonal patterns. While sales activity has slowed significantly, experts suggest the cooling market may not necessarily lead to a notable decrease in home prices. The slump is officially beyond seasonal.

stories.title: Las Vegas luxury market defies inventory surge
stories.summary: Las Vegas housing inventory reached a record high of 11,447 units in October as high mortgage rates cooled demand. Despite the broader market slump, the luxury tier continues to outperform. Affordability headwinds are clearly not a universal experience for all property segments in the metro area.

stories.summary: Nearly 500,000 square feet of life sciences space was let across Oxford, Cambridge and London in the first nine months of 2026, a 12 percent increase over last year. However, Q3 lettings dropped 65.7 percent compared to Q2. The golden triangle is currently seeing a quieter period.

stories.title: Cardiff office rents climb
stories.summary: Prime office rents in Cardiff have risen by over a third in two years, with projections suggesting rates could approach £40 per square foot. Developers cite high construction and borrowing costs as barriers to new grade A stock. The city is currently short on space to expand.

stories.summary: Aritzia is in late-stage talks to occupy the former House of Fraser flagship on Oxford Street. stories.title: Salisbury approves industrial park expansion
stories.summary: Salisbury City Council has annexed and rezoned 362 acres on Peeler Road to allow for a new industrial park. The project will eventually feature six buildings, including one exceeding one million square feet. The land was previously under county jurisdiction before the unanimous vote for city inclusion.

stories.title: Industrial spaces look to grow | WilmingtonBiz
stories.summary: Bill Early, executive director of Brunswick Business & Industry Development, closely watches industrial development in the region. And right now, there’s a lot to watch. In Navassa, Samet Corp. recently completed a 160,000-square-foot building off Cedar Hill Road. The Greensboro-headquartered company completed its first 200,000-square-foot

stories.title: Broker builds on industrial activity
stories.summary: Will Leonard of Cape Fear Commercial has become a go-to broker for industrial real estate in Wilmington. While specializing in a single product type is common in larger markets like Raleigh or Charlotte, industry peers note that such focus remains rare in the Wilmington area.

stories.title: Charlotte industrial developers face power grid limits
stories.summary: Industrial developers in Charlotte are struggling to secure energy for small-bay projects as they compete with data centers and large manufacturers. Some sites require 10 megawatts despite not being data centers. Demand is currently surpassing availability, leaving developers to vie for a limited power supply.

stories.title: Doors and Spaces Industrial acquires New Jersey portfolio
stories.summary: Doors and Spaces Industrial and Devli Real Estate have acquired a six-building, 46,250-square-foot industrial portfolio in Middlesex County, New Jersey. The firms aim to capitalize on an acute regional shortage of functional flex industrial space designed to serve local trade, logistics and essential service operators.

stories.title: OmniTRAX expands Blue Island logistics hub
stories.summary: OmniTRAX has signed new tenants at its City of Blue Island Commercial Center, a multi-modal logistics hub in a Chicago suburb. The company says the site's strategic location is why customers come and stay. The influx of leases has prompted plans for a second phase of development.

stories.title: Riot Platforms leases Texas data center for US$28 billion
stories.summary: Riot Platforms has signed a 15-year lease for its 910 MW Corsicana data center in Texas to an unnamed AI lab, with Anthropic named as the first tenant. The deal could reach US$54 billion if extension options are exercised. The project will be delivered in three phases.

stories.title: Indian Railways generates revenue from scrap
stories.summary: Indian Railways generated 628.49 crore rupees through scrap disposal, exceeding its 600 crore target. The campaign also freed up more than 14 acres of space across various railway establishments. The ministry recorded significant achievements in cleanliness, e-waste management and the timely disposal of pending matters.

stories.title: Meghalaya CM inaugurates Chokpot projects
stories.summary: Chief Minister Conrad Sangma inaugurated several development projects in Chokpot, including a new block office, farmers market and two bridges. The integrated block office complex was constructed at a cost of 2.77 crore rupees. The CM also held a session to address local infrastructure needs.

stories.title: Bihar launches river water metro
stories.summary: Bihar has launched a 50-seater catamaran service on the Ganga river in Patna to promote tourism and provide an alternative transport route. The vessel uses a hybrid engine to minimize air and water pollution. Officials hope the service will help commuters bypass congested city roads.

stories.title: Hyderabad airport adds CAT III lighting
stories.summary: GMR Hyderabad International Airport has commissioned CAT III airfield ground lighting for its runway. The upgrade is intended to enable aircraft operations in lower visibility conditions. The airport expects the change to reduce weather-related flight diversions and delays, particularly during the winter fog season.

stories.title: Bengaluru metro blue line trials advance
stories.summary: Trial runs on Bengaluru's Blue Line Metro corridor are progressing toward mainline testing. Development Minister Krishna Byre Gowda stated the government is committed to completing pending works to strengthen urban connectivity. The Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited has moved a step closer to bringing the line into service.

stories.title: Yamuna cruise service launches in Delhi
stories.summary: A recreational river cruise service has launched on the Yamuna in Delhi with tickets priced at 500 rupees. Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal inaugurated the project, noting that waterways are the most powerful mode of transportation. The minister added that no nation can grow without utilizing its river systems.

stories.title: Lucknow approves 431 crore development package
stories.summary: The Lucknow Development Authority has approved a 431 crore rupee development package, including four multi-level parking facilities and land for a new Metro yard. The parking projects are expected to accommodate 1,500 vehicles. The authority also greenlit the expansion of a local medical institute.

stories.title: India infrastructure spending reaches 12.2 lakh crore
stories.summary: India's public capital expenditure has risen from 2 lakh crore rupees in 2014 to 12.2 lakh crore rupees in the current fiscal year. The government says this investment supports integrated planning across transport, logistics and housing, creating a foundation for sustained economic growth.

stories.title: Palakkad residents demand airport
stories.summary: Participants at a district-level consultation meeting in Palakkad have requested the construction of a local airport. MP V K Sreekandan stated the proposal is under consideration by the Union civil aviation ministry. The meeting focused on leveraging the district's potential in agriculture, tourism and infrastructure development.

stories.title: NMDC in talks with Russia for lithium
stories.summary: State-run miner NMDC is in talks with Russia's Rosatom to invest in lithium projects. The move is part of a strategy to secure supplies for the battery and EV industries. NMDC has formed a team for due diligence as the government seeks to reduce import dependence.

stories.title: Haryana RERA denies additional compensation claim
stories.summary: The Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has dismissed a claim for additional compensation by plot buyers at Emerald Floors Premier. The adjudicating officer held that allottees who accept possession are entitled to interest for delays, rather than separate compensation for the same cause.

stories.title: Supreme Court rules on ancestral property
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that a grandson has no birthright in property devolved on his father through the partition of a grandfather's estate. The bench held that ancestral property does not automatically become the grandson's, dismissing a claim for a half share in a Chennai property.

stories.title: NCLT flags undervalued HDIL property sale
stories.summary: The National Company Law Tribunal is investigating a 2019 property transfer by HDIL directors Rakesh and Sarang Wadhawan. The sale of the Bandra West office space occurred on the same day the Bank of India insolvency petition was reserved for orders. Timing remains a focus of the scrutiny.

stories.title: New York sues federal government over Seneca Nation land
stories.summary: New York State has challenged federal decisions granting restricted-fee status to 207 acres on Grand Island and other properties donated to the Seneca Nation. The lawsuit against the Department of the Interior and the Bureau of Indian Affairs seeks to undo the land's protected status. Sovereignty remains contested.

stories.title: Federal policy blamed for Boston housing crisis
stories.summary: A report from the Boston Foundation says federal policies have fueled population declines and weakened the regional economy, worsening the local housing crisis. Home values have risen 50% and rents 35% since 2019. The report suggests years of underbuilding will require years of effort to resolve.

stories.title: San Francisco social housing measure defeated
stories.summary: Proposition I, which sought to fund affordable housing via a transfer tax on sales over $10 million, has failed. The measure trailed 52-48 after $2.8 million in opposition spending from real-estate groups and developers. The city's transfer tax revenue will continue to fluctuate without the new mandate.

stories.title: Milan prosecutors seek to drop planning probe
stories.summary: Milan prosecutors have requested the dismissal of a case involving the city's mayor and a real estate magnate. The investigation concerned urban planning activities. The request follows standard legal procedures in the region.

stories.title: Saint Augustine’s University bankruptcy hearing scheduled
stories.summary: Saint Augustine’s University faces a bankruptcy hearing on Tuesday to discuss its reorganization plan. The school, which is not holding classes this semester, is seeking court approval for a deal with real estate advisor Avison Young to redevelop its campus. The formal plan remains under court review.

stories.title: Sunway REIT reports retail growth
stories.summary: Sunway REIT reported a 1.7% increase in nine-month net property income to RM501.2 million. Retail income rose 12% to RM395 million, offsetting the loss of revenue from the disposed Sunway University campus. The trust continues to focus on retail performance to drive its overall income.

stories.title: AmanahRaya REIT repossesses Wisma ELM
stories.summary: AmanahRaya REIT has repossessed the Wisma ELM office building in Kuala Lumpur after its corporate tenant vacated early. The lease agreement is terminated. The tenant accounted for 7% of the trust's gross annual rental income. The REIT manager is now pursuing rights to recover outstanding rent.

stories.title: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance reports Q3 results
stories.summary: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance deployed $85 million in new fundings this quarter, maintaining a 14.8% weighted average yield. The company reported net interest income of $12.5 million, a 2.3% decrease from the prior quarter. It continues to operate with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.48x.

stories.title: CT REIT maintains high occupancy in Q3
stories.summary: CT Real Estate Investment Trust reported third-quarter sales of C$161.32 million and net income of C$51.02 million. With portfolio occupancy at 99.5%, the firm committed capital to a C$14 million acquisition and a C$22 million redevelopment. The company remains focused on expanding its income-producing footprint.

stories.title: Singapore real estate deals expected to slow
stories.summary: Singapore's record-breaking year for real estate deals is expected to subside as borrowing costs rise. A planned S$5.7 billion transaction for the Marina One complex reportedly stalled amid pricing gaps and lengthy negotiations. Investors are finding that record volume is difficult to sustain in the current environment.

stories.title: BTB Real Estate Investment Trust reports Q3 revenue
stories.summary: BTB Real Estate Investment Trust reported third-quarter revenue of CA$31.5 million. The company is currently reshaping its portfolio through targeted property dispositions and industrial acquisitions. Further details are available in the company's full financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

stories.title: BTB REIT continues portfolio optimization
stories.summary: BTB Real Estate Investment Trust reported its third-quarter 2026 results, highlighting the sale of two office properties in Trois-Rivieres. The trust is shifting its focus toward the industrial segment. Management stated the disposals were necessary to align with current investment objectives.

stories.title: Sunrise Realty Trust announces Q3 earnings
stories.summary: Sunrise Realty Trust reported GAAP net income of $2.9 million for the third quarter of 2026. Distributable earnings reached $3.2 million, or $0.24 per share. The company operates as a lender on the Tannenbaum Capital Group real estate platform.

stories.title: Independence Realty Trust and Centerspace merger approved
stories.summary: Stockholders of Independence Realty Trust and shareholders of Centerspace have voted to approve their planned merger. The transaction will combine the two entities' portfolios. Further details regarding the integration process are available in the companies' regulatory filings.

stories.title: BREIT writes down assets despite fundraising gains
stories.summary: Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust recognized $496.7 million in impairment charges on 14 commercial properties and single-family homes during the third quarter. Despite the write-downs, the fund returned 2% to investors and reported a 40% increase in subscriptions. Fundraising is at its highest level since 2022.

stories.title: JLL Income Property Trust declares distribution
stories.summary: JLL Income Property Trust has declared a November distribution of $0.0525 per share. The payment represents an annualized distribution rate of approximately 5.6% based on a net asset value of $11.25 per share. The distribution is scheduled for payment on or around November 24.

stories.title: Granite REIT reports higher FFO and acquisitions
stories.summary: Granite Real Estate Investment Trust reported increased third-quarter funds from operations and closed $270.5 million in new acquisitions. The trust also raised its distribution by 4.2%. The company continues to expand its holdings while increasing payouts to unitholders.

stories.title: Tranchi plans AI-powered real estate financing
stories.summary: Tranchi announced plans to launch an AI-powered Debt Service Coverage Ratio financing platform by the end of 2026. The company says the platform will replace manual loan application and underwriting workflows with specialized AI agents. The software aims to bring an integrated financing experience to real estate investors.

stories.summary: Equity Angels has launched its third accelerator cohort, focusing entirely on go-to-market strategy for four proptech founders. Participants will spend six weeks building a blueprint to improve human adoption of their products. As one advisor noted, AI can increase product output, but it cannot increase human adoption.

stories.title: RESAAS integrates real estate data with Google Cloud
stories.summary: RESAAS Services is integrating its proprietary real estate data with Google Cloud, allowing enterprise customers to query the information using Gemini AI models. The company says the move enables clients to leverage unique data within their own secure AI environments. Existing customers already use Google Cloud infrastructure.

stories.title: Equity Angels announces new proptech accelerator cohort
stories.summary: Equity Angels has selected four startups for its third accelerator cohort, which is the firm's first program dedicated to go-to-market strategy. The startups focus on areas including brokerage data, live AI sales support and commercial site analysis. The program pairs founders with marketing, communications and growth leaders.

stories.title: The risks of relying on multiple AI home valuations
stories.summary: When three independent AI systems provide similar home valuations, homeowners may view the agreement as confirmation of accuracy. However, if the systems operate under the same market assumptions, the similarity may offer no additional assurance. The numbers can be influential, even if the consensus is manufactured.

stories.title: Bamburi Cement seeks low-carbon procurement support
stories.summary: Bamburi Cement is urging the Kenyan government to prioritize lower-carbon building materials in public tenders and green-finance rules. The company is currently expanding its clinker capacity to support industrial projects. It wants policy support to help shape the market for greener construction materials in the country.

stories.title: Goldsun Building Materials reports steady third-quarter profit
stories.summary: Goldsun Building Materials reported a third-quarter net profit of NT$905 million, or NT$0.77 per share. The company attributed the performance to construction demand from major Taiwanese technology companies expanding their plants. Earnings per share remained flat compared to the previous quarter.

stories.title: Hanil Cement focuses on specialty products
stories.summary: Hanil Cement is shifting its strategy toward specialty cement and smart construction technologies. The company recently ranked first in three categories of the 2026 Korean Quality Satisfaction Index. It is currently developing products designed to withstand demanding weather conditions and specific construction site requirements.

stories.summary: Boise Cascade has completed the acquisition of two building materials distribution facilities in Rocklin and Sanger, California, from Taiga Building Products. The transaction includes inventory, equipment and rolling stock. The locations will now operate under the Boise Cascade name as part of its distribution network.

stories.title: B5 Plus Group wins construction award in Ghana
stories.summary: B5 Plus Group was named the Most Outstanding Construction Materials Manufacturing and Supply Company at the 2026 Ashanti Business Merit Awards. The recognition celebrates the company's industrial leadership and contribution to economic development in Ghana. The award was presented on 30 October 2026.

stories.title: German plant tests carbon capture for batteries
stories.summary: A waste treatment plant in Eschbach, Germany, is testing a project to capture CO2 from incineration and convert it into solid carbon. Researchers believe the technology could provide an alternative to fossil-based carbon for batteries and construction materials. The project uses liquid metal to extract the carbon.

stories.title: Construction product sales fall for third quarter
stories.summary: The Construction Products Association reported a third consecutive quarterly decline in product sales volumes. The group cited weak demand, rising input costs and geopolitical uncertainty as factors delaying project starts. Annual inflation for construction materials reached 6.5 percent in the third quarter, double the consumer price index.

stories.summary: TCC Group Holdings reported October revenue of NT$16.357 billion, a 17.83% increase year-on-year and a record high for the month. Asia Cement saw revenue fall 6.9% to NT$5.431 billion in the same period. The two companies are currently moving in opposite directions.

stories.title: Inditex commits $50 million to supplier green fund
stories.summary: Inditex has committed $50 million to a fund led by the International Finance Corporation to help small suppliers transition to net-zero models. The retailer describes the partnership as the first of its kind. The textile industry accounts for 8% of global greenhouse gas emissions.
